verdict.rationale: skills.sh's CLI explicitly supports project-mode installs that are 'committed with your project, shared with team' (default location), plus repo-based distribution via GitHub shorthand/URL for public or private repos, CI/CD-friendly non-interactive installs, and org-wide search — directly enabling an engineering lead to standardize and distribute skills via shared repo or committed files. The public leaderboard/marketplace at skills.sh adds a discovery layer. missing for 10: independent verification of team-adoption workflows at scale, and community skepticism about missing version-pinning/update guarantees (comm-4) leaves some distribution lifecycle questions only partially documented.
